description: Run an analysis case (the RunAnalysis RPC, the REPL's %analysis): its subject and inputs bound from the arguments and its own declarations, its body run, every declared output answered with the verdict of its objective and of each assertion in its body; a verification case also answers its own verdict. A trade study's evaluations of each alternative are in `evaluations`. Under an explore schedule the answer is the set of distinct `outcomes`. Bounded by the service's OPENSYSML_MAX_* budgets. The result is the RunAnalysisResponse as protojson writes it.

arguments.description: positional values for the case's input parameters, each a protojson Value; the subject is never among them. Example arms: {"intValue":"7"}, {"realValue":1.5}, {"boolValue":true}, {"stringValue":"x"}, {"quantity":{"realMagnitude":5.0,"unit":"m"}}, {"enumLiteral":{"literalId":"Colors::red"}}

engine.description: the analysis engine asked; empty is auto

modelHash.description: the model_hash a parse answered; give this, or paths and/or sources to parse first

namedArguments.description: values for input parameters by name, each a protojson Value. Example arms: {"intValue":"7"}, {"realValue":1.5}, {"boolValue":true}, {"stringValue":"x"}, {"quantity":{"realMagnitude":5.0,"unit":"m"}}, {"enumLiteral":{"literalId":"Colors::red"}}

paths.description: model files to parse as one model, absolute or relative to the workspace root

schedule.description: scheduling policy for choice points: declared, reverse (the default), seed:<n>, or explore[:runs=<n>,depth=<d>]

sources.description: documents given inline, parsed with paths as one model

language.description: sysml or kerml; empty is inferred from path's extension, sysml when it has none

path.description: name the document is reported by in diagnostics and indexed under; a .kerml extension makes it KerML unless language says otherwise

text.description: the document's source text; empty is an empty document

strictConformance.description: judge the documents as conforming SysML v2: notation no pinned production admits is an error rather than a warning

subjectSymbolId.description: qualified name of a part/usage to instantiate as the case's subject, or a path from one; empty leaves the case's own subject binding to supply it

symbolId.description: qualified name of the analysis case definition or usage

toolDryRun.description: run the case only to the first external tool call its ToolExecution names and answer what the tool would be given in toolDryRun, without starting it (sysml -tool-dry-run); refused under explore

name: run_analysis
